meta.description: Control status of TC regions. Year 1914. Iron Wall = crescent from Caspian (N of Tehran) to Red Sea.

FAITHFUL_ISLAMIC.name: The Faithful (Iron Sultanate)
FAITHFUL_ISLAMIC.description: The Great Sultanate behind the Iron Wall of Dhu al-Qarnayn

HERETIC.name: Forces of Hell
HERETIC.description: Earthly Domains of Hell — demons, heretics, and the damned

NEUTRAL.name: Neutral / Independent
NEUTRAL.description: Not directly aligned with either side

kalmar_union.note: The Kalmar Union (Scandinavia). Remote northern territories under Faithful control.

crown_england.note: The Crown of England, Kingdom of Eire, Kingdom of Alba and Wales. Project Invincible launched the Moving Fortress of Britannia.

france.note: Kingdom of France. The Antipope of Avignon is a heretical schismatic threat in the south.

holy_roman_empire.note: The Holy Roman Empire — Germanic heartlands, including the Free State of Prussia.

iberia.note: Castille-Aragon Union & Kingdom of Portugal. The Breach of Cordoba (1910): Heretics struck from Gibraltar.

papal_states.note: The Papal States. Seat of the Church Militant and naval power in the Mediterranean.

hungary.note: Kingdom of Hungary and Principality of Wallachia. Bulwark against the Balkan Heretic advance.

balkans.note: Frontline. Heretic Rijeka seized in 1872. Greece holds firm. The Sacred Order of the Dragon defends Wallachia.

plc.note: Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. Includes the Free State of Prussia and Teutonic Order.

kyiv.note: Principality of Kyiv. Eastern Orthodox Faithful holding the steppes.

novgorod.note: Czardom of Novgorod. Vast northern forests and the Kingdom of Perm.

anatolia.note: After the destruction of Byzantium, all of Anatolia fell to the forces of Hell. The Taurus Mts mark the northern anchor of the Iron Wall.

golden_khanate.note: The Golden Khanate. Steppe nomads maintain uneasy independence.

caucasus.note: Alamut endures outside the Iron Wall — protected by warped time and space. A brutal contested frontier.

new_antioch.note: Principality of New Antioch. Duke Constantine XI commands. The Home of All Our Hopes, first line of defence. Carcass Front to the north.

levant.note: The Gate of Hell opened in Jerusalem 1099. The Levant is the Earthly Domain of Beelzebub. Inverted pyramids and temples to the Princes of Hell.

iron_sultanate.note: Behind the Iron Wall (Caspian to Red Sea crescent). Tehran, Aleppo, Baghdad, Mecca within. Damascus is a Gate. Four Great Gates. Never broken.

morocco.note: Kingdom of Morocco. Northern coast near Heretic Gibraltar is contested.

numidia.note: Kingdom of Numidia — part of the anti-Heretic coalition with Nubia and Abyssinia. Resisting Mammon's westward advance.

libya.note: Under Heretic control. Staging ground for Mammon's push toward Numidia and Mali.

domain_mammon.note: Domain of Mammon (Prince of Greed). Egypt and Sudan consumed. Knights of Avarice strip all wealth. Pushing toward Numidia and Abyssinia.
